text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, as I'm heading out of the
school building, I come
upon a
somber-looking Fuji Kiseki gazing out the
window.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, what sweet kids, practicing so hard.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just the grounds. The little ones are
staying after school for extra
training.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Each one of them is speeding off with big,
bright eyes, their paths
aimed straight
toward their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Their dreams as racers...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to run to make others happy, but I
don't know... Something
inside me is
saying that alone is not quite enough.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I fear it will take more than that to become
Fuji Kiseki, the greatest
entertainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good gracious! My feelings just come right
out when I'm around you,
don't they?
Actually, let me take you up on
that—there's somewhere I
want to go.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Shall we make it a date, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy to accompany Fuji Kiseki for the
night. Our destination is...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is our destination for tonight. Behold,
the Okan Classic Hotel.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Perfect for a date, wouldn't you
say?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I joke. You see, this hotel holds within it
a theater!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And today there's an important play. My
dear friend—no, my former
rival—is about
to make her stage debut.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We've been friends since our children's
theater days. It would always
be me and
her competing for the lead role.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When she chuckled, the audience laughed.
When she cried, the
audience sobbed.
She's truly an outstanding talent.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
However, that's not the only thing that
made her fearsome...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She did, very much so. All that remarkable
ability, and she was never
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But I don't believe I've ever lost in my
desire to bring happiness to
others. Still,
there was a decided difference between
us.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And on tonight's stage, I mean to ascertain
exactly what that was.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the curtains rise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The young woman's performance is a sight
to behold. She shines
bright, never ceasing
to captivate the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her every gaze and gesture radiates
tremendous passion. She is
without a
doubt the star of the show.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Eclipse, incomparable goddess, I beg you
smile upon me. Now, with
my dream in
pieces, I need the strength to stand again."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Should my one wish to win this fight be
granted, I would pledge my
undying soul
to you. Place the everlasting crown upon
my head!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A great play indeed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Her spellbinding performance left me in
awe. Whether whispered or
shouted forth,
I felt each word plunge right into me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In the moment, I didn't realize what was
making my body tremble so
hard.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But now I know. It's passion—a passion for
acting—that drives one to
become their
ideal self.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's also the enthusiasm to be the best. The
unbreakable feeling,
bordering on
obsession, to follow one's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's the kind of star performer who held
me transfixed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I saw what lies beyond...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The dream that lies beyond making others
happy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That was a tour de force I'll never forget.
Congratulations on your
debut as a lead
performer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text:
Fuji! You came to watch me?! This is
great—I wanted you, more than
anyone, to
be here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was so amazed, that I'm still spinning. It pains me to say it, but tonight, you were the greatest entertainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't mean I admit defeat, though.
One day I'm going to
surpass you and give
everyone an enchanting show they'll never

forget!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text:
And I'm going to climb to the top of the
theater world. We may be on
different
stages, but you're my rival, now and
forever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored. Then let us both pursue our
dreams to their ends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji shakes hands with her friend, who
listens gleefully to those kind
words
before departing with a wave.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's peculiar. My body feels hot, down to
the core. I can't help wanting
to run right
this instant.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer, I'm really glad we got
to see this play together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I was actually scared at first—of having to
stare right into the very
thing I still lack.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But with you there by my side, I was able
to see what's past the point
of simply
becoming the ideal me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel uncertain anymore, thanks to
you. I'll never forget this
day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Say, what's wrong? You got so quiet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's this? Have you perchance
become smitten with me? Well,
not that I
would mind, of course!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Just joking! Let's get out of here before I
get in trouble for breaking
curfew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the time, I begin to panic, and
we start sprinting toward
the train station.
